enabled.description: Turns the analyzer on (true) or off (false). Only true turns on an analyzer that is off by default.

Analyzer.description: Analyzer is an optional analyzer with no settings besides enabled.

syntax.description: The ast-grep syntax pass. The report uses it for function size. Absent: off.

cargo_modules.description: Reads the module graph inside Rust crates. It compiles the crate. Absent: off.

roslyn.description: Reads the .NET type graph with the Roslyn helper. Absent: on where the helper is installed.

graph.description: A dependency between two modules must be an allowed dependency. Absent: ask.

coupling.description: New knowledge across a module boundary needs a balance of at least min_balance. Absent: deny.

duplication.description: Knowledge that another module already owns is not copied. Absent: ask.

cycle.description: No new cycle between modules. Absent: deny.

layers.description: Dependencies follow the layer order. Absent: deny.

unowned.description: New production code belongs to a module. Absent: deny.

min_balance.description: The lowest balance the coupling rule accepts, from 1 to 10. Absent: 7.

Builtin.description: Builtin holds the modes of the built-in rules and the minimum balance.

enabled.description: Makes the report read the sources. It needs at least one source. Absent: false.

Coverage.description: Coverage names coverage files for the report.

path.description: The path of the coverage file, relative to the repository root.

format.description: The format of the file. Absent: auto, found from the content.

sidecar_path.description: The file that records the source hashes. Absent: <path>.sidecar.json.

max_bytes.description: The largest file the report reads. Absent: 67108864 (64 MiB).

max_facts.description: The largest number of coverage facts the report keeps. Absent: 1000000.

from.description: A module name or a path glob, or a list of them.

to.description: A module name or a path glob, or a list of them.

Deny.description: Deny names the source and the target of a forbidden dependency.

enabled.description: Turns the extractor on or off. Absent: auto, which reads the language when its files exist.

projects.description: The .slnx, .sln, .slnf or .csproj files to read, relative to the repository root. Absent: the first .slnx or .sln at the root, else every .csproj outside obj/, bin/ and excluded paths.

rule.description: The id of a built-in or custom rule.

from.description: The module the errors come from. For unowned, the glob of the code no module owns.

to.description: The module the errors reach. Required for every rule except unowned and a custom only rule, which have no target: an only rule names its library itself.

expires.description: The last day the exception holds, as YYYY-MM-DD. After it, while the code still breaks the rule, every change fails. Absent: no date.

Exception.description: Exception permits errors of one rule in one place, with a reason and usually a date.

enabled.description: Turns the extractor on or off. Absent: auto, which reads the language when its files exist.

modules.description: Selects go.work members. Absent: every member.

include.description: Keeps only the members that match. Absent: every member.

exclude.description: Drops the members that match, after include. Absent: none.

GoModules.description: GoModules selects go.work members by globs relative to the repository root.

enabled.description: Turns the extractor on or off. Absent: auto, which reads the language when its files exist.

Language.description: Language is a language extractor with no settings besides enabled.

Languages.description: Languages holds one block per language extractor.

paths.description: Globs of the files that belong to the module.

public.description: Globs other modules may use. Absent: the whole module is public. Add public to protect its inside.

volatility.description: How often the module is expected to change. Absent: taken from subdomain (core is high; supporting and generic are low), otherwise high.

subdomain.description: The business role of the module. It sets the volatility only when volatility is absent. Absent: no business role is recorded.

layer.description: A name from layers. Absent: the module has no layer.

depends_on.description: The modules this module may depend on. Absent: the module may depend on no other module.

Module.description: Module is a named set of paths with a public part, a volatility and the modules it may depend on.

use.description: A library import path or a package set: network, process or database.

in.description: The module, or a list of modules, that may use it.

Only.description: Only names a library or package set and the modules that may use it.

enabled.description: Turns the extractor on or off. Absent: auto, which reads the language when its files exist.

package.description: The top-level importable package, such as myapp. Absent: found from the layout, src first.

id.description: The rule's short name, as in a linter. It appears in every error.

deny.description: Forbids a dependency from these modules or paths to those. It needs instead.

only.description: Keeps a library, or a named package set (network, process, database), in the listed modules.

note.description: A rule nothing checks today, written down. It shows as "not checked".

instead.description: What to do instead. Required for deny.

Rule.description: Rule is a custom rule: exactly one of deny, only or note, with its reason.

enabled.description: Turns the extractor on or off. Absent: auto, which reads the language when its files exist.

manifest.description: The path of Cargo.toml. Absent: the root manifest.

features.description: The cargo features to turn on. Absent: the default features.

include_dev_deps.description: Adds dev-dependencies as crate dependencies. Absent: false.

enabled.description: Turns the analyzer on (true) or off (false).

timeout.description: A Go duration, such as 5m. Absent or zero: the analyzer's own limit.

TimedAnalyzer.description: TimedAnalyzer is an optional analyzer with a time limit.

owners.description: GitHub logins of the people who write the policy and answer requests.

gate.description: Whether the check blocks a pull request. Absent: advisory, so the check reports and does not block.

layers.description: Layer names, inner first. Absent: no layer rule.

modules.description: The modules: named sets of paths, keyed by module name.

builtin.description: Changes the modes of the built-in rules. Absent: the defaults of each rule apply.

rules.description: The custom rules. Absent: none; the built-in rules still apply.

exceptions.description: Permissions to break one rule in one place. Absent: none.

generated.description: Globs of generated code, which the rules skip. Absent: only listed paths are out; a file name that looks generated is not enough.

tests.description: Globs of test code, which the rules skip. Absent: only listed paths are out.

exclude.description: Globs of paths that no extractor reads, such as vendored or fixture trees. Absent: only the built-in exclusions apply.

languages.description: The settings of each language extractor.

analyzers.description: The settings of the optional analyzers.

coverage.description: Coverage files that your CI writes. The report reads them; Archfit never runs tests.

title: Archfit policy (schema 3)
description: The Archfit policy, .archfit.yaml: modules, allowed dependencies, rules and exceptions. Archfit 4 reads it. Archfit 3 reads version 2 and uses the schema of tag v3.4.0.
